variable.description: Batch ID or Journal Batch Number (e.g. 6a781281bca6423be5cc93c6 or Mesco-000013814)

request.description: Returns the full raw body, captured D365FO HTTP request/response payloads, application logs, and posting errors for a batch ID or journal number.

item.name: Get D365FO Response by Journal Batch Number

request.description: Queries D365FO OData API live for the specified JournalBatchNumber (e.g. Mesco-000013814) and returns the full D365FO header, line items, and logs.

item.name: Check Journal Amount and Duplication Integrity

variable.description: D365FO Journal Batch Number to validate

request.description: Reads the complete live Finance header and lines, compares expected and actual line counts and debit/credit totals per currency, and reports confirmed duplication separately from review-only repeated business signatures. duplicationConclusion NO_EXTRA_FINANCE_DATA means Finance has no additional rows or amount; CONFIRMED_DUPLICATION means definite duplicate evidence; REVIEW_REQUIRED needs manual review.

item.name: Delete D365FO Journal by Journal Batch Number

variable.description: D365FO Journal Batch Number to delete (e.g. Mesco-000014781)

request.description: Finds the journal in Finance (Vendor Payment, Ledger, Customer Payment, or Vendor Invoice), deletes dependent lines, then deletes the header. Use to clear SpecTrans blockers / doubled journals before re-upload. Posted journals may be rejected by Finance. No auth required.
